run_jobset_parallel_jobs: run a list of JobSpec subprocesses in parallel with configurable max jobs and timeout
create_jobspec_subprocess: create a JobSpec to define a subprocess command with environment variables, timeout, and retry settings
run_jobset_with_retries: run parallel jobs with automatic flake retries and timeout retries for flaky tests
run_jobset_cpu_cost: run parallel jobs with CPU cost tracking to limit concurrent jobs based on core usage
run_jobset_cancel_on_failure: run parallel jobs that stop execution and kill remaining jobs on first failure
